title: 番外II 紫虚异域日记Ⅲ
content_zh:
紫虚在爆炸来临的瞬间习惯性的散成了气态，对于能量攻击，紫虚研究多年之后发现，只要自己分散成气态，貌似攻击对于自己的伤害会轻很多。
紫虚虽说成功无伤躲开了爆炸，但这并不代表这件事就结束了，准确的说现在紫虚的麻烦才来了！
“受死吧，你这个强盗！”紫虚当然不是笨蛋，在恢复成人形之后就知道自己闯祸了，直接从佛塔的窗口飞了出去，不过刚刚出去的瞬间一道攻击就朝着他袭来。
单手弹开攻击之后，紫虚当即化光准备飞走，不想一大片金色的光刃朝他袭来，统统都是内气外放的招数，当即将紫虚吓了一个半死，虽说他在仙人之中算是顶尖，但是战斗就不是仙人的本行。
不过在攻击临身之后，紫虚就发觉这种内气外放不过是空有其形，而无其神，对于仙人来说，内气的伤害对于他们并不算严重，反倒是内气离体外放的内气之中灌注的精神意志更容易伤害到他们。
随意的从攻击之中穿过去，本身就有些恣意妄为的紫虚，直接冲了上去，想要仔细探查一番，不过背后那股雄浑的内气，让紫虚非常清楚此地不宜久留。
随意的飘落，随意的探查，随意的将这群人按到了土地里面，并且加上了一层法术，让他们完全没有可能爬出来，已经确定情况的紫虚，当即化作紫色流光朝着东南方向飞去。
西南什么的紫虚就算是傻也不会去了，之前一路往西南飞，就算他对于自己的隐藏很自信，但是内气离体这种生物，有些时候无意间反倒会发现自己，而这鬼地方跟中原一个样，内气离体并不少。
“给我留下！”紫虚化光飞离的瞬间，城中猛地爆发出一团金光朝着他拦去，这等货真价实的内气离体攻击，就算是紫虚也不得不闪开，不过也是因为这么阻了一阻，身后那道金光猛地追了上来。
“麻烦……”紫虚一个幻影再次闪现在数十米外，和内气离体的武将不同，仙人的秘术道术非常多，战斗未必可怕，但是保命能力绝对不容小视。
不过这个时候前后皆是出现了一名内气离体的高手，紫虚不由得有些凝重，说实话他也完全没想到，自己只是捏了两下，那玩意居然会爆炸，神石居然会爆炸？
抽出自己的武器，紫虚化光朝着前方那名高手直接扑去，而对方在紫虚冲过来的瞬间面上浮现了一抹狞笑，身上骤然出现一层金色外相，显化出来的好几根胳膊直接朝着紫虚攻去。
“佛陀？”紫虚神色凝重，但是却没有多少惊讶，这一路他已经见到无数的佛像，内气离体显现个这个也没有什么好惊讶的。
再说紫虚非常清楚这个时候绝对不能恋战，就算是吕布单人突入城池也会被干掉了，更何况他还不是吕布。
紫虚在冲向对方的瞬间，身后那名内气离体也骤然爆发出金光朝着紫虚身后袭去，而紫虚却置若罔闻。
在手上的长剑和正面的那个佛陀外相交击的瞬间，紫虚猛然爆发出无尽的光芒，这一刻整个邬阁衍那城都覆盖在那耀眼的白光之中，刹那光辉之下，白昼降临。
紫虚在所有人闭眼的瞬间，顺手将自己的长剑捅到了正面的那个佛陀外相之中，然后引爆了武器之中储蓄的内气，当初刘备的守护仙人给紫虚说过在黄河中的事情，紫虚也就跟着学了一下。
虽说没有文丑那一招重创许褚这种顶级高手的威力，但爆发出来的力量依旧在佛陀外相上炸出了一个大洞，紫虚顺手就将长剑递了进去，在对方左胸开出了一个洞。
死没死，紫虚是不知道，但是这已经足够他逃跑了。
等紫虚以惊人的速度撤出邬阁衍那之后，城池上骤然出现了浓密的云气，紫虚不由的心生庆幸之感，虽说对方的反应非常快，但是和奉高那种军魂军团主动调用还是有相当的差距。

“给我止住！”紫虚刚刚飞出，还未等到飞离，那个之前追着他的内气离体就紧跟着飞了出来，而且身边还带了两个大和尚，至于之前正面阻止他的那个内气离体，不知道是死了，还是重创了。
“谁停谁脑子有病啊！”紫虚嗤笑道，直接化作一道紫光朝着东南飞去，而后面的三人也都拿出自己的全力朝着紫虚追去。
四人的速度都是超乎想象的快，短短两个时辰就进入印度洋，不过这种速度对于四人压力都是超乎想像的大，不过对于紫虚来说，不跑肯定会被搞死，而后面三人失落了帝国重宝，不追也会死！
四人一逃三追，不到一天的时间就飞过了东南亚的岛屿，进入了太平洋，不过这个时候紫虚已经消耗过大，再飞就无法承受这种压力了，同样后面三人也好不到哪里去。
无奈之下紫虚只能就地展开战斗，没办法，自从飞过那片不知名的岛屿之后，紫虚基本没有再遇到过土地，这也就导致紫虚想要落到岛上隐藏休息一下都没可能了。
这一片除了海水就是海水，根本没有别的任何东西，紫虚被追杀的时候也没有时间去看方向，反正以超乎想象的速度可劲飞的结果就是所看到的一切都是海水。
既然已经找不到能躲的地方，紫虚也清楚自己再跑估计连战斗力都没了，也就狠下心来扭头和对面一战
当然紫虚虽说够强，但对方三打一，而且配合默契，差点将紫虚打死，好在动手没多久就遇到了天灾级别的风暴，然后紫虚直接将三人和自己一起拉到天灾之中，成功干掉了对方。
不管怎么说，仙人的生存能力是非常可怕，而且是有备而来，成功逃出升天，不过紫虚也累得够呛，加了一层防护之后，就随风飘荡，最后被海水，还是动物什么的顶到南半球了。
不过这都属于紫虚醒来之后才知道的事情，话说刚刚醒来的紫虚完全不知道他已经到了南半球，他只是躺在海里面，随着海浪波动，直到晚上的时候，紫虚才注意到问题……
之前被追杀完全没有留心头顶的星相，之后也不知道沉睡了几天，醒来发现天变了，紫虚表示自己有点懵。
研究了一夜天象之后，紫虚表示自己完全看不懂自己在哪里了，好在第二天太阳依旧升了起来，估摸了一下太阳应该是在东边，于是他就朝着他估算的南边飞去。
以当前能承受的最快速度往他估计的南方飞了几个时辰，估摸着再飞几个时辰就能跨过南回归线的时候，紫虚突然想起来一件非常惊悚的事情，自己是往南飞是吧，但是太阳怎么在他身后……
紫虚表示自己有些懵，于是又朝着太阳飞了俩时辰，太阳落山了，好吧，这不是最可怕的，最可怕的是，紫虚飞的时候是下午，他不确定他飞的是西北，还是西南，反正肯定不是标准方向。
夜幕降临，紫虚一脸懵懂的看着这完全不知道怎么回事的天象，反正，看起来都不怎么眼熟，最终紫虚终于确定，他已经迷路了。
content_en:
Zixu habitually disperses into a gaseous state at the moment of an explosion. As for energy attacks, Zixu discovered after many years of research that as long as he disperses into a gaseous state, it seems that the attack will cause much less damage to him.
Although Zixu successfully avoided the explosion without any injuries, it does not mean that the matter is over. To be precise, Zixu's trouble is now coming!
"Suffer death, you robber!" Of course Zixu was not a fool. After returning to his human form, he knew that he was in trouble and flew out of the window of the pagoda. However, the moment he left, an attack hit him.
After deflecting the attack with one hand, Zixu immediately turned into light and prepared to fly away. Unexpectedly, a large golden blade of light came towards him. All of them were moves to release internal energy. Zixu was frightened to death. Although he was considered the best among immortals, fighting was not the skill of immortals.
However, after the attack came, Zixu realized that this kind of internal energy released outside was just empty and had no spirit. For immortals, the damage caused by the internal energy was not serious to them. On the contrary, the spiritual will infused in the inner energy released from the outside was more likely to hurt them.
Passing through the attack at will, Zixu, who was a bit wanton in his own right, rushed forward and wanted to investigate carefully, but the powerful inner energy behind him made Zixu very clear that it was not suitable to stay here for a long time.
Randomly falling, casually exploring, and casually pressing the group of people into the ground, and adding a layer of magic to make it impossible for them to climb out, Zixu, who had determined the situation, immediately turned into a purple streamer and flew towards the southeast.
Even if Zixu is stupid, he won't go to the southwest. He flew all the way to the southwest before. Even if he is very confident in his concealment, creatures such as the inner qi separated from the body will sometimes find themselves accidentally. And this ghost place is just like the Central Plains, and there are not many inner qi separated from the body.
"Leave it to me!" The moment Zi Xu turned into light and flew away, a ball of golden light suddenly burst out from the city and headed towards him. Even Zi Xu had to get out of this genuine internal energy separation attack, but because of this blockage, the golden light behind him suddenly caught up.
"Trouble..." A phantom of Zixu flashed dozens of meters away again. Unlike the generals whose inner energy left the body, the immortals have many secret arts. Fighting may not be terrible, but their ability to save lives must not be underestimated.
However, at this time, a master whose inner energy was separated from the body appeared before and after. Zixu couldn't help but feel a little solemn. To be honest, he didn't expect it at all. He just pinched it twice, and the thing would actually explode. The divine stone would actually explode?
Pulling out his weapon, Zixu turned into light and rushed directly towards the master in front of him. The moment Zixu rushed towards him, a sinister smile appeared on his face. A layer of golden appearance suddenly appeared on his body, and several of his manifested arms attacked Zixu directly.
"Buddha?" Zixu looked solemn, but not too surprised. He had seen countless Buddha statues along the way, so there was nothing surprising about the inner energy appearing out of the body.
Besides, Zixu knew very well that he must not fall in love with fighting at this time. Even if Lu Bu broke into the city alone, he would be killed, not to mention that he was not Lu Bu.
The moment Zixu rushed toward the opponent, the inner-qi person behind him suddenly burst out with golden light and struck behind Zixu, but Zixu turned a deaf ear.
At the moment when the long sword in his hand collided with the Buddha in front of him, Zixu suddenly burst out with endless light. At this moment, the entire Ugoyan City was covered in the dazzling white light. In an instant, daylight fell.
When everyone closed their eyes, Zixu stabbed his long sword into the Buddha's appearance in front of him, and then detonated the inner energy stored in the weapon. Liu Bei's guardian immortal told Zixu what happened in the Yellow River, and Zixu followed suit.
Although there is no literatureChou's move severely damaged the power of a top master like Xu Chu, but the burst of power still blasted a big hole in Buddha's appearance. Zixu conveniently handed the long sword in and made a hole in the opponent's left chest.
Zixu didn't know whether he was dead or not, but this was enough for him to escape.
After Zixu withdrew from Ugeyana at an alarming speed, dense clouds suddenly appeared on the city. Zixu couldn't help but feel lucky. Although the other party's reaction was very fast, it was still far behind Feng Gao's active call of the military soul army.
"Stop it!" Zixu had just flown out, and before he could fly away, the Nei Qi Li Body who had been chasing him flew out right after him, and there were two great monks with him. As for the Nei Qi Li Body who had stopped him head-on, he didn't know whether he was dead or seriously injured.
"Whoever stops is mentally ill!" Zixu sneered and turned into a purple light and flew towards the southeast, while the three people behind him also used all their strength to chase Zixu.
The speed of the four of them was unimaginable, and they entered the Indian Ocean in just two hours. However, the pressure on the four of them at this speed was unimaginable. However, for Zixu, if he did not run, he would definitely be killed, and the next three lost the empire's important treasure, and they would die if they did not chase!
The four of them escaped and were chased three times. In less than a day, they flew over the islands in Southeast Asia and entered the Pacific Ocean. However, by this time Zixu had already consumed too much, and they would not be able to withstand the pressure if they flew any further. Likewise, the three behind them were not much better.
In desperation, Zixu could only fight on the spot. There was no other way. Since flying over the unknown island, Zixu had basically never encountered land again, which made it impossible for Zixu to land on the island to hide and rest.
There was nothing else in this area except sea water. When Zixu was being chased, he had no time to look in the direction. Anyway, as a result of flying at an unimaginable speed, all he saw was sea water.
Since he could no longer find a place to hide, Zixu also knew that if he ran away, he would probably lose his fighting power, so he turned around and fought with the opponent.
Of course, although Zixu was strong enough, the opponent fought three against one and cooperated tacitly, almost beating Zixu to death. Fortunately, he encountered a natural disaster-level storm not long after the attack. Then Zixu directly pulled the three of them and himself into the natural disaster, and successfully killed the opponent.
In any case, the immortal's survivability is very terrifying, and he came prepared and successfully escaped to heaven. However, Zixu was also very tired. After adding a layer of protection, he drifted with the wind, and was finally pushed to the southern hemisphere by sea water or animals.
But this was all something that Zixu only knew after he woke up. Zixu, who had just woken up, had no idea that he had arrived in the southern hemisphere. He was just lying in the sea, following the waves. It was not until night that Zixu noticed the problem...
He didn't pay attention to the stars above his head when he was being chased before. After that, he slept for an unknown number of days. When he woke up, he found that the sky had changed. Zixu said that he was a little confused.
After studying the celestial phenomena for a night, Zixu said that he could not understand where he was at all. Fortunately, the sun still rose the next day. He estimated that the sun should be in the east, so he flew towards the south where he estimated.
After flying towards the south for a few hours at the fastest speed he could bear, and expecting to cross the Tropic of Capricorn in a few more hours, Zixu suddenly remembered something very scary. He was flying south, right, but why was the sun behind him...
Zixu said that he was a little confused, so he flew towards the sun for another two hours. The sun set. Well, this was not the scariest thing. The scariest thing was that it was afternoon when Zixu flew. He was not sure whether he was flying northwest or southwest. It was definitely not the standard direction anyway.
As night falls, Zixu looks confusedKnowingly looked at this celestial phenomenon that he had no idea what was going on. Anyway, it didn't look very familiar. In the end, Zixu finally determined that he had lost his way.
